text:
Three words of strength
I
There are
		three lessons I would trace

with a burning pen that scorched deeply,
leaving a trail of light
		blessed
wherever a mortal heart beats.


II
Have Hope. If there are storm clouds,
if there are disappointments and no
		illusions,
unfurrow your brow; its shadow is vain,
for every night
		is followed by a morning.


III
Have Faith. Wherever your boat is driven
by roaring breezes or
		raging waves,
God (do not forget) rules heaven,
and earth,
		and breezes, and the little boat.


IV
Have Love, and love not just one being,
for we are brothers from
		pole to pole,
and spend your love for everyone's good,
as the sun
		pours out its friendly light.
V

		Grow, love, hope! Engrave the three within you,
and wait firm and
		serene
for strength where others may founder,
light when many
		wander in darkness.

		Translated by Rafael Pombo
